scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 36 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-chateau-de-montebello-vi-1-emissa.story: A 380 km round trip from Bellinzona - roughly 6 h 33 in the saddle. The stops in between: Sacri Monti of Piedmont and Lombardy, Sacro Monte del Rosario di Varese, Sacro Monte di San Francesco d’Orta San Gi and VI.1-Emissario. The highest point is about 1,550 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
